QUOTE: "Add the `MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` define to the module's public header (for example `include/mbedtls/asn1.h`), in that module's code range. The generator picks it up from the headers." and "Do not edit `library/error.c`. It is regenerated at build time"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add the define to the public header, not to edit error.c, and to rebuild so the generator runs. It doesn't mention the /** */ doc comment, but its closing caveat says the exact comment format is unconfirmed.
